data.narrative:
Galadyne is a pre-seed stage company in Defense & Security founded by Chandler Luzsicza that has raised $4.8M to date. The Defense & Security sector contains 26 private companies and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS), with notable private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The valuation analysis relied on stage-progression methodology, as peer-median triangulation was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables in the narrow peer set. The stage-progression method uses the $4.8M raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Pre-Seed to next-stage advancement, implying a valuation of $12M. This represents a meaningful but not atypical markup from capital deployed, reflecting risk and dilution assumptions embedded in standard pre-seed advancement patterns.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $10M to $14M, with a median point of $12M. The range reflects reasonable bounds around the single applicable method rather than cross-method consensus. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight peer comparables at this stage and valuation tier, limiting external validation of the step-up multiplier assumption. Further clarity on product development status, customer traction (if any), and technology differentiation relative to the peer set would materially inform positioning within this range.
